groups.title: Black Bulls
groups.def: Every registered Magic Knight of the Black Bulls squad shown in the anime.

groups.title: Golden Dawn
groups.def: Every registered Magic Knight of the Golden Dawn squad shown in the anime.

groups.title: House Vermillion
groups.def: Every member of House Vermillion by blood shown in the anime.

groups.title: Grew Up at Hage Church
groups.def: The two boys raised there and the sister and priest who raised them, as shown in the anime's opening episodes.

groups.title: House Silva
groups.def: Every member of House Silva by blood shown in the anime.

groups.title: Magic Knight Captains
groups.def: Everyone shown or stated in the anime to hold a Magic Knights squad captaincy, current or former. Crimson Lion has two (Fuegoleon and his temporary replacement Mereoleona), Julius held Aqua Deer's (then Grey Deer) captaincy before becoming Wizard King, and the late Acier captained Silver Eagle before her son Nozel (ep. 108). Vice-captains (Langris, Kirsch, Nacht, Randall, Yuno) don't count; Nacht and Yuno only become captains in the manga.

groups.title: Fire Magic Users
groups.def: Every character shown casting Fire Magic from their own grimoire in the anime, including Mars, whose grimoire was patched with Fana's fire affinity (ep. 18-19) - not Rhya, who can temporarily copy any attribute he witnesses, fire included.

groups.title: Water Magic Users
groups.def: Every character shown with Water as their own magic attribute in the anime, including the Seabed Temple priest Gio - not Rhya, who can temporarily copy any attribute he witnesses, water included, and not Acier, a Steel Magic user whose devil-given Water Magic is manga-only (ch. 372).

groups.title: Wind Magic Users
groups.def: Every character shown with Wind as their own signature magic attribute in the anime - not Rhya, who can temporarily copy any attribute he witnesses, wind included.

groups.title: Elves
groups.def: The elf tribe's named leadership, seen either 500 years ago or reincarnated into human vessels during the present-day Reincarnation arc. Dozens of ordinary Magic Knights (Nils Ragus, Cob Portaport, Risacca Ondell and more) were also briefly possessed by rank-and-file elves during that arc; neither those knights nor the minor elves who rode them count here.

groups.title: Eye of the Midnight Sun
groups.def: Every willing member of the present-day terrorist group Eye of the Midnight Sun shown in the anime, elf and human alike, including the rogue witch Catherine (captured in the Royal Capital raid, ep. 26; sacrificed by Patolli, ep. 95) - not the many Magic Knights whose bodies were briefly hijacked as unwilling vessels during the Reincarnation arc. Licht, the elves' leader from 500 years ago, predates the group and doesn't count either.

groups.title: Royal Knights
groups.def: Everyone named to the Royal Knights squad after the selection exam in the anime (ep. 87), including its leader Mereoleona and the two captains who joined, Nozel and Rill. Exam entrants who weren't picked (Magna, Sol, Finral, Leopold, Langris, Sekke, Solid, Dmitri, Rick, Curtis, Forte and others) don't count.

groups.title: Mana Zone Users
groups.def: Every character shown creating a Mana Zone, a rare feat of only the most powerful mages, in the anime (eps. 1-170). Nacht's (ch. 272 p. 11+) and Langris's (ch. 305) Mana Zones come after the anime's cutoff, so they don't count.

groups.title: Witches
groups.def: Every witch of the Witch Queen's forest shown in the anime.

groups.title: Spatial Magic Users
groups.def: Every character shown casting Spatial Magic as their own attribute in the anime, including Zenon, whose devil Beelzebub gives him spatial cubes (eps. 161, 167) - not Rhya, who can temporarily copy any attribute he witnesses, spatial included, and not Lily, whose devil-given Spatial Magic is manga-only (ch. 335).

groups.title: Names That Are Also English Words
groups.def: Character names that are also English dictionary words: Gauche, Grey, Jack, Lily, Luck, Mars, Mimosa, Rill, Sally, Solid, Kirsch (cherry brandy), Kaiser (emperor), Charlotte (a dessert), Rob (to steal), Forte (a strong point), Nix (to veto), Digit (a numeral or finger) and Cob (a corn cob). Sol (the musical note) also counts. Near-misses that don't count: Noelle, Vanessa, Magna, Henry, Fragil (missing the 'e' of 'fragile') and Ben, Rick, Puli, En (only names, or too obscure a technical/dialect term).

groups.title: Silver Eagle
groups.def: Every Magic Knight shown in the anime as a current or former member of the Silver Eagle squad, including its late former captain Acier (flashback) and Mohl, an ex-member turned bandit (anime-only ep. 86).

groups.title: Blue Rose
groups.def: Every registered Magic Knight of the Blue Rose squad shown in the anime.

groups.title: Crimson Lion
groups.def: Every Magic Knight shown in the anime as a current or former member of the Crimson Lion squad, including Theresa, a retired Crimson Lion turned nun.

groups.title: Aqua Deer
groups.def: Every Magic Knight currently registered to the Aqua Deer squad shown in the anime - not the several who started there before moving on (see Former Aqua Deer Members).

groups.title: Green Mantis
groups.def: Every registered Magic Knight of the Green Mantis squad shown in the anime.

groups.title: Coral Peacock
groups.def: Every registered Magic Knight of the Coral Peacock squad shown in the anime.

groups.title: Purple Orca
groups.def: Every Magic Knight shown in the anime as a current or former member of the Purple Orca squad, including Rades, expelled before the series. Zora was never a member: he only knocked out the real Purple Orca vice-captain Xerx Lugner and took his place for the Royal Knights exam (ep. 73).

groups.title: Former Aqua Deer Members
groups.def: Characters explicitly shown to have started their careers in the Aqua Deer squad before moving on to a different post, in the anime.

groups.title: Devil Hosts
groups.def: Characters shown in the anime (eps. 1-170) to carry a devil and draw on its power: Asta (Liebe, living in his grimoire; formal contract in ep. 170), Nacht (four devils, ep. 168) and the Dark Triad - Dante (Lucifero), Vanica (Megicula), Zenon (Beelzebub). Not Julius or Yami, whose devils are manga-only, nor Lolopechka, who was only cursed by Megicula.

groups.title: Seabed Temple
groups.def: The Seabed Temple's priestly family shown in the anime (eps. 39-51): High Priest Gifso, his son Gio, and Gio's children Kiato and Kahono. No other universe name belongs to the temple.

groups.title: Blood Sibling in Another Squad
groups.def: Magic Knights shown in the anime to have a brother or sister by blood serving in a different squad: Noelle (Black Bulls) and her Silver Eagle siblings Nozel, Solid and Nebra; Finral (Black Bulls) and Langris (Golden Dawn); Kirsch (Coral Peacock) and Mimosa (Golden Dawn). Not Fuegoleon, Leopold or Mereoleona (siblings, but all Crimson Lion), not Asta and Yuno (raised together, not related), and not non-Knight siblings (Lumiere and Tetia, the Zogratis trio, Kiato and Kahono).

groups.title: Great Spirit Hosts
groups.def: Characters shown in the anime as the chosen host of one of the great elemental spirits: Yuno (Sylph, wind), Fana and later Fuegoleon (Salamander, fire) and Lolopechka (Undine, water). Not Rhya, who only copies Salamander's Breath with Imitation Magic, and not Noelle, whose bond with Undine is manga-only (ch. 295).

groups.title: Metal Magic Users
groups.def: Characters whose magic attribute in the anime is a metal: Klaus and Acier (Steel; Acier's is described in ep. 72), Nozel (Mercury), Sekke (Bronze), Ben (Copper) and Cesc (Shakudo, a copper-gold alloy). Mineral (Mars), Crystal (Rick), Rock (Curtis), Stone (Galgaria) and Sandstone (Ruben) are not metals.

groups.title: Squad Vice-Captains
groups.def: Characters shown serving as a Magic Knights squad's vice-captain during the anime's present-day story: Langris (Golden Dawn, until the time skip), Yuno (Golden Dawn, after it, ep. 159), Kirsch (Coral Peacock), Randall (Crimson Lion) and Nacht (Black Bulls, ep. 168). Yami and William, shown as Grey Deer vice-captains only in an anime-only flashback years before the story (ep. 86), are captains throughout it and don't count.

groups.title: Light or Dark in Other Languages
groups.def: Names that mean light or darkness in another language: Licht (German/Dutch 'light'), Lumiere (French 'light'), Fana (Amharic 'light'), Yami (Japanese 'darkness'), Nacht (German/Dutch 'night') and Nero (Italian 'black'). Near-misses that don't count: Sol ('sun'/'soil'), Selena ('moon'), Grey (a colour), Fuegoleon ('fire lion'), Zora ('dawn').
